scope: Reconcile primary open-source DWG/DXF implementation claims with distinct semantic, carrier, projection, and native-consumer evidence layers; calibrate the existing FreeCAD scale/annotation acceptance gate.

sourceTypes: FreeCAD current importer source, documentation, and issue tracker
localPlanAreasReviewed: PAR-07 / PAR-37 / 7V POLYLINE and mesh routes
FreeCAD native-consumer and DXF unit-scaling gates
method.evidenceRule: Repository capabilities and issue reports are route-specific leads, not a semantic vote. Mutable source/docs require a revision pin before runtime qualification; application behavior must be measured on an exact build and profile.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG explicitly assigns class stability levels and distinguishes same-version unknown-bit persistence from general conversion. ACadSharp advertises typed versioned DWG/DXF routes but needs per-class/release evidence. ezdxf documents ASCII/binary DXF read/write and third-party content retention while its ACIS handling is limited. GDAL exposes projected explicit geometry and a separate raw ASM carrier mode for AC1027+; it does not create 3D solid geometry. These sources are mutually useful but no one source proves end-to-end format, graph, solid, and consumer semantics.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS B-rep validity or native CAD acceptance
runtime behavior of an unpinned mutable source revision
evidence.planUse: Keep exact wire, typed parse, opaque carrier, entity attachment, projection, shape semantics, and native-consumer results as separate matrix cells. Pin the exact peer route/build at composed checkpoints; do not add peer installs/runs to every fast implementation slice.

evidence.observed: Legacy POLYLINE encodes distinct 2D, 3D-polyline, polygon-mesh, and polyface modes using flags and child VERTEX roles. Polyface coordinate and face vertices differ; face indices are signed one-based references, negative signs mark invisible starting edges, and readers should tolerate noncanonical coordinate/face ordering even though writers should emit coordinate vertices first.
doesNotEstablish: validity of every malformed index/order variant
a libdxfrw gap beyond existing PAR-37/7V scope
evidence.planUse: Retain the existing mode-specific and completed-pool tests; no duplicate issue or test owner is warranted by this cross-check.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD documentation freshness and importer profile
evidence.observed: GitHub marks the FreeCAD documentation repository archived on 2026-04-01. The documentation remains a route-profile snapshot distinguishing C++ and optional legacy Python importers and configurable import behavior. Current mutable C++ source reads a manual dxfScaling option and records selected import settings; source inspection is not a run of an exact application build.
doesNotEstablish: effective options for any particular installed FreeCAD binary
current support for every documented entity
native semantic acceptance by source inspection alone
evidence.planUse: Pin the FreeCAD build/backend and capture effective preferences/import statistics at the existing composed native checkpoint; do not require native runs for individual parser slices.

evidence.observed: As reviewed on 2026-10-16, issue #30043 is open and labeled confirmed. The reporter reproduces in FreeCAD 1.1.1 that a Draft text Scale Multiplier of 10 is also applied to imported text height when text/dimension import is enabled. Current importer source separately records its manual scale setting. This is a reported application-consumer defect, not a DXF/libdxfrw failure, and may vary by build/profile.
doesNotEstablish: the issue's status on a later run date
a defect in libdxfrw writer or DXF unit metadata
behavior of every annotation or importer backend
evidence.planUse: Split the existing FreeCAD gate into geometry-only identity/nonidentity scale checks, annotation-height identity-scale checks, and optional nonidentity annotation calibration reported separately. Record exact build/backend/effective settings/document values and recheck issue status before the scheduled native run. If reproduced, do not score the annotation failure as a file-format loss.

implementationReadiness.localFastCadence: No change: touched strict targets, one focused existing fast test, required compatibility compile, and diff check per slice; no routine native/peer/full-suite execution.
implementationReadiness.nativeCadence: One composed native checkpoint with exact platform, build, importer backend, effective preferences, converter and intermediate file identity.
